methods.what: Separation of time variable with exponential decay ansatz in radial diffusion equation
Frobenius power-series ansatz and recurrence for coefficients
Series solution (spherical Bessel type) regular at origin
Eigenvalues from boundary condition at r=c via zeros of f
Orthogonality integral of eigenfunctions with weight r^2
